prs.title: Editorial: Change `computedrole` to computed role
prs.author: spectranaut
prs.body:
🚀 **Netlify Preview**:
🔄 **this PR updates the following specs**:
- [core-aam preview](https://deploy-preview-2955--wai-aria.netlify.app/core-aam/index.html) — [core-aam diff](https://services.w3.org/htmldiff?doc1=https%3A%2F%2Fw3c.github.io%2Fcore-aam%2F&doc2=https%3A%2F%2Fdeploy-preview-2955--wai-aria.netlify.app%2Fcore-aam%2Findex.html)

I wanted to link a definition of "computed role" in https://github.com/w3c/aria/pull/2800 but realized it was original defined in terms of "computedrole" (one work all lower case). I suppose this was to match web driver, but I don't think we need to define the computed role concept that way, and using two words matches "computed accessibility properties".
